canonical.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Cuines 33

parent.title: A weekend in Knokke, anchored on Cuines 33

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Cuines 33
siblings.summary: Four hotels within a 15-minute walk of Cuines 33, ranked by proximity and fit for a 2-Michelin-star dinner night, plus the borderline picks past 1.4 km.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Cuines 33
siblings.summary: Bruges is the obvious heavyweight; the Zwin, Het Zoute, Damme, Sluis and Cadzand-Bad each earn a half-day for their own reason. Decision matrix, distances, and what to skip.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Cuines 33
siblings.summary: Inside the 30 km circle, the IT scene runs through Bruges (Howest + EUSIPCO 2026) and Oostende. Knokke-Heist itself hosts no IT conferences.

sources.title: MICHELIN Guide ceremony — Cuines 33 awarded two stars 2026
sources.claim: Cuines 33 was promoted to two MICHELIN Stars in the 2026 Belgium & Luxembourg guide.

sources.title: Cuines 33 — MICHELIN Guide restaurant page
sources.claim: Cuines 33 sits at Smedenstraat 33, 8300 Knokke-Heist — central Knokke, ~160 m from Knokke train station.

sources.title: Hotel Britannia — official site
sources.claim: Hotel Britannia is a 4-star Anglo-Norman villa hotel in Het Zoute at Elizabetlaan 85.

sources.title: Hotel Britannia — Let's Go My Love
sources.claim: Britannia is a 1928 villa by architect Buylaert, fully renovated in 2022; 100 m from the beach.

sources.title: Hotel Manoir du Dragon — official site
sources.claim: Hotel Manoir du Dragon, Albertlaan 73, sits next to the Royal Zoute golf course; rated 9.2/10 across 103 reviews.

sources.title: Manoir du Dragon — HRS listing
sources.claim: Manoir du Dragon is a 4-star, 16-room boutique with individually decorated rooms, some with private terraces or fireplaces.

sources.title: Hotel Pavillon du Zoute — official site
sources.claim: Hotel Pavillon du Zoute is the 4-star Norman-style villa at Bronlaan 4 with restaurant, English garden, indoor pool and sauna.

sources.title: Pavillon du Zoute — Belgian Coast listing
sources.claim: Pavillon du Zoute dates to 1923 and is built in the Anglo-Norman style; 39 rooms.

sources.title: La Réserve Knokke-Heist — official site
sources.claim: La Réserve is a 5-star superior resort opposite the Knokke casino, with spa, indoor pool, La Rigue restaurant and signature bar.

sources.title: La Réserve — MICHELIN Guide hotel page
sources.claim: La Réserve reopened in 2023 after a design overhaul by Belgian architect Glenn Sestig.

sources.title: Hotel Auberge St. Pol — official site
sources.claim: Hotel Auberge St. Pol sits at Bronlaan 23 in Het Zoute, recently renovated in modern eco-design with superior rooms and junior suites.

sources.title: Lebeau 19 — official site
sources.claim: Lebeau 19 by Livingroom is a 26-room boutique hotel with bar/brasserie at Zoutelaan 175 in Het Zoute.

sources.title: Lebeau 19 — myboutiquehotel listing
sources.claim: Lebeau 19 is rated 8.3/10, sits near 4 golf courses and the Zwin Nature Reserve.

sources.title: Strandhotel Cadzand-Bad — official site
sources.claim: Strandhotel Cadzand-Bad is a Dutch-coast hotel directly on the dunes, with heated indoor pool, sauna and Auping-bedded rooms.

sources.title: Strandhotel Cadzand — Studio Piet Boon project page
sources.claim: Strandhotel Cadzand's interiors and Piet Boon-designed furniture come from Studio Piet Boon.

sources.title: Hotel Noordzee Cadzand-Bad — official site
sources.claim: Hotel Noordzee Cadzand-Bad is a 4-star boutique on the dunes at Noordzeestraat 2 with two saunas, steam bath and pool.

sources.title: De Lindenhoeve — official site
sources.claim: De Lindenhoeve in Sluis is a converted family farmhouse boutique with 8 themed rooms plus a separate lodge and on-site restaurant.

sources.title: ViaMichelin route Cadzand-Bad → Knokke-Heist
sources.claim: Cadzand-Bad to Knokke-Heist is ~14 km / ~17 minutes by car.

sources.title: Knokke-Heist boutique hotels — myboutiquehotel
sources.claim: Britannia has 26 rooms; La Réserve Resort has 37 rooms; Lebeau 19 has 26 rooms.

sources.title: Auberge St. Pol — Booking.com
sources.claim: Auberge St. Pol is 3-star Superior, rated 8.9/10 by guests; superior rooms feature private terraces or balconies.
